name: DL Holdings Co. Ltd.
summary: DL Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a diversified conglomerate, operating through its subsidiaries across numerous sectors including construction, petrochemicals, energy production, manufacturing, hospitality, cultural institutions, and education. Its construction division undertakes a wide range of projects, from industrial plants and civil infrastructure to commercial buildings and residential developments. In the petrochemical sector, the company supplies various products, including synthetic resins and other plastic materials. DL Holdings is also active in the energy industry, with ventures in thermal and wind power generation. Its manufacturing interests extend to automotive components and motorcycles, alongside concrete pipes and other structural concrete products. The company additionally offers comprehensive real estate services, covering development, consulting, property management, and rentals. Within its leisure and cultural portfolio, DL Holdings manages hotels and specialized art museums focusing on photography, design, and fashion. It also operates a university dedicated to cultivating skilled professionals. Established in 1939, DL Holdings Co.,Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
